nfl.oneThing: The Eagles have placed Jalen Hurts on injured reserve with a blood clot. He won't play until Week 11 at the earliest, and the reports say he could be out for as long as three months.

headlines.title: Hurts placed on injured reserve with a blood clot
headlines.summary: The Eagles have put Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after a long round of consultations with doctors. The superficial blood clot in his calf had moved, which raised concern for both Hurts and the team. He's out at least four weeks and won't play until Week 11 at the earliest, and reports say he's sidelined indefinitely. ESPN reports that blood thinners are a likely treatment, with an average course of about six weeks, but he could be out for up to three months, which would effectively end his season. Philadelphia is 2–3 on a three-game losing streak.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Eagles are 1.5 games behind the Giants in the NFC East, and the division race is now much harder without their starting quarterback.

headlines.title: Caleb Williams set to return for the Bears
headlines.summary: Caleb Williams is expected to start for the Bears against the Falcons on Sunday after missing three games with a torn hamstring. He hasn't played since Sept. 20 against the Vikings, but he was a full participant in practice all week and took starter reps. Coach Ben Johnson said Williams is 'on track'. Chicago is 3–2 after winning the two games Williams missed, but it lost to the Packers last week with Tyson Bagent at quarterback. In his limited time this season, Williams has thrown for 407 yards and two touchdowns.
headlines.whyItMatters: Chicago is 3–2 and seventh in the NFC, so getting its starting quarterback back is important in the wildcard race.

headlines.title: Packers place three on injured reserve before the Cowboys
headlines.summary: Green Bay has placed defensive linemen Jonathan Ford and Javon Hargrave, and receiver Skyy Moore, on injured reserve before Sunday Night Football against Dallas. Cornerback Benjamin St-Juste was the only other player ruled out. Receiver Savion Williams was activated from injured reserve, and practice squad players Arron Mosby and Coleman Owen were elevated to fill the gaps. The Packers are already without Micah Parsons, who has a left knee ACL injury and is out after surgery, and Josh Jacobs, who is out for personal reasons.

headlines.title: Cowboys' next two games are must-wins
headlines.summary: Dallas is 2–3 and has alternated wins and losses. Its most recent loss came against Tampa Bay, where the offence scored just 16 points. The NFC East is wide open, with the Giants leading at 3–1–1, but Dallas is 12th in the NFC.
headlines.whyItMatters: A loss in either game would put the Cowboys in a deep hole in a division that's still winnable.

nba.oneThing: The Spurs will open the season against the Thunder with De'Aaron Fox, Stephon Castle and Dylan Harper in the backcourt, alongside Devin Vassell and Victor Wembanyama.

headlines.title: Spurs open with a three-guard lineup
headlines.summary: The Spurs will start De'Aaron Fox, Stephon Castle and Dylan Harper alongside Devin Vassell and Victor Wembanyama against the Thunder in the opener, according to ESPN. The three guards made their debut together in the 126–97 preseason win over the Kings, where Harper scored 19 points and Fox added 16 points and six rebounds. Some fans have called the lineup a grave mistake, and the question of where it leaves Fox is still being asked.
headlines.whyItMatters: Starting three guards on opening night is the first real test of how the young backcourt fits together.

headlines.title: Spurs pick up rookie options on Castle, Harper and Bryant
headlines.summary: The Spurs have exercised the 2027–28 rookie-scale options on Stephon Castle, which is a fourth-year option, and on Dylan Harper and Carter Bryant, which are third-year options. Teams have until Monday, November 2, to decide on the next rookie-scale options.
headlines.whyItMatters: The decisions commit the Spurs to three of their young players for 2027–28.

headlines.title: Knicks waive Bruce Brown; Wiseman set for the final spot
headlines.summary: The Knicks have waived guard Bruce Brown after failing to find a trade that would keep both him and James Wiseman. New York needed to send out a player on a standard contract to stay below the second apron, and it couldn't send money in a deal. Even with 11 second-round picks over the next seven drafts, no trade partner came through. Wiseman is expected to take the final roster spot, and the Knicks could still trade for someone after the opener and bring Brown back.
headlines.whyItMatters: The move shows how tight New York's cap situation is under the second apron.

headlines.title: Nuggets' Julian Strawther out with a knee sprain
headlines.summary: Julian Strawther sprained his left knee in a preseason game at the Clippers and will be out indefinitely. Denver will reevaluate him in six weeks. The 24-year-old guard and forward is a versatile player for the Nuggets.
headlines.whyItMatters: Denver loses a versatile wing for at least the early part of the season, and the six-week reevaluation sets the next checkpoint.

recaps.text: Golden State held off Portland 128–118 in a preseason game that looked like an upset on paper. Stephen Curry had 20 points and five assists, and Brandin Podziemski and Yaxel Lendeborg each scored 17. Damian Lillard had 23 points for Portland, and Ja Morant added 19. Draymond Green's 10 assists were a big part of the Warriors' playmaking.

recaps.keyLine: Markkanen 19 pts, 5 reb, 1 ast · Jackson Jr. 17 pts, 3 reb, 0 ast · Green 18 pts, 2 reb, 2 ast, 3 stl · Brooks 18 pts, 4 reb, 1 ast
recaps.text: Utah beat Phoenix 119–116 on the road. Lauri Markkanen had 19 points and five rebounds, and Jaren Jackson Jr. added 17. For Phoenix, Jalen Green and Dillon Brooks scored 18 each, and Devin Booker had six assists, but it wasn't enough to hold the lead.

recaps.keyLine: LaVine 20 pts, 3 reb, 3 ast, 3 stl · Simmons 14 pts, 8 reb, 7 ast · Harper 19 pts, 0 reb, 4 ast · Fox 16 pts, 6 reb, 3 ast
recaps.text: The Spurs beat the Kings 126–97 at home. Dylan Harper scored 19 points and De'Aaron Fox had 16 points and six rebounds, with Keldon Johnson adding 15. The three-guard group of Fox, Harper and Castle played together for the first time in a preseason win. Sacramento is 0–5, so the scoreline says less than the lineup does.

recaps.keyLine: Davis 14 pts, 11 reb, 1 ast · George 14 pts, 3 reb, 1 ast · Bey 19 pts, 6 reb, 2 ast · Fears 14 pts, 3 reb, 5 ast, 3 stl
recaps.text: New Orleans beat Washington 107–106. Saddiq Bey had 19 points for the Pelicans, and Jeremiah Fears had five assists and three steals. Anthony Davis had 14 points and 11 rebounds for the Wizards, and Alex Sarr added nine rebounds. Washington is without Jamir Watkins, who has a left knee injury.

recaps.keyLine: Gonzalez 21 pts, 4 reb, 3 ast · Harper Jr. 16 pts, 3 reb, 3 ast · Embiid 27 pts, 8 reb, 5 ast · Maxey 22 pts, 3 reb, 6 ast
recaps.text: Boston beat Philadelphia 125–120 in overtime. Joel Embiid had 27 points and Tyrese Maxey added 22 points and six assists, but Hugo Gonzalez's 21 points carried the Celtics. Jaylen Brown had 20 points and eight rebounds for the 76ers. Philadelphia is also missing Ariel Hukporti, who ruptured his right Achilles.

contextCard.title: How Exhibit 10 contracts work
contextCard.body: An Exhibit 10 contract is a non-guaranteed deal for a player trying to make an NBA roster. If the player is cut, the contract can include a bonus for joining the team's G League affiliate. That's why so many waived players are expected to head to G League teams this week.
